also: something to go with the bread

terms.gloss: anything eaten with bread: meat, fish, vegetables, a sauce
evidence: Plaut. Aul. 316: pulmentum prīdem eī ēripuit mīluos
terms.comment: Shortened from pulpāmentum (Lewis & Short). The later form pulmentārium has the same sense.

phrases.latin: pulmentum prīdem eī ēripuit mīluos: homō ad praetōrem plōrābundus dēvenit
phrases.english: a kite once snatched a bit of meat from him: the fellow went off in tears to the magistrate
